name: backupSuccessRatePercentage
definition: The share of attempted device backups that completed, as a percentage: devices in backup_applied_on divided by devices in backup_applied_on plus backup_failed_on, across the backup plans the tool reads. No completed attempt, an error, refusal, empty read, or any plan without both lists is Not evaluated, never 0.
population: the backup plans the credential's company returns; denominator = device entries in backup_applied_on plus backup_failed_on across every plan read; pending devices are excluded
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A read of the backup plans in which every plan carries backup_applied_on and backup_failed_on lists and at least one device appears in either. An error, refusal, empty or partial read, or a read with no attempts, is Not evaluated.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real IDrive body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: Rounded to two decimals. With no attempted backups there is nothing to divide by, so the rate is null (Not evaluated), not 0 and not 100. Devices in backup_pending_on are reported but not in the rate.
